crossRefs.note: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.
Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out, fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill…
‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward, and fell to the ground.
Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge.
Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge.
Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be…
Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

translations.web: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.
translations.bsb: Then my enemies will retreat on the day I cry for help. By this I will know that God is on my side.
translations.kjv: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God
translations.asv: Then shall mine enemies turn back in the day that I call: This I know, that God is for me.
